mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_comment (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, is_secret) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{secret})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.content END AS content, c.is_secret, (c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_deleted, c.created_at FROM blog_comment c JOIN blog_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT user_id FROM blog_comment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT parent_id FROM blog_comment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_comment SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
